- `tools/r09-e2a-entry-rerun.ps1` 增补两项环境供给（显式 `--outbound.exports.*` 参数仍优先）：`OUTBOUND_EXPORTS_RENDERER_HOME=<tree>/report-rendering/build/install/acrylic-report-rendering`；`OUTBOUND_EXPORTS_BROWSERS=` 树内 `report-rendering/build/browsers`，不存在时**回退到 `D:/acrylic-pda-worktrees/r08-export/report-rendering/build/browsers`**（即那些 IT 自己硬编码的同一份 Playwright chromium；树内自建的正式做法是 `gradlew :report-rendering:installChromium`，需联网，本轮未跑）。跨树引用已声明。
